QuestInfo.name: Uncomfortable Saddle II
QuestInfo.0: #p1013000# seems to have something he wants to say. Could it be that he's gotten too big for the saddle again? Talk to #b#p1013000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1013000# says that the saddle is too small and it's difficult for him to even fly. He's going to need a new saddle. It's going to be expensive... Go to #p2060005# in #m230000000# and ask for another saddle.
